title: Erdoğan Warns Old World Order Is Collapsing in AK Party Group Speech
detail: Speaking to the AK Party parliamentary group in Ankara, Erdoğan said no one knows what will replace the collapsing old world order, citing the Russia-Ukraine war and renewed Gulf tensions, and urged Muslim countries to press Israel over Gaza. He also marked the party's 2002 election victory anniversary.

media.caption: Erdoğan addresses AK Party group meeting
